note: 第一輪沒有任何候選模型/adapter 通過 baseline 門檻，registry 目前是空骨架。禁止在沒有 baseline + 固定 eval + rollback 前建立 candidate 條目。

candidate_schema.base_model: string — e.g. ollama/qwen2.5:14b (must match model-tier-policy.md T3 row)
candidate_schema.change_type: prompt | skill | metadata_filter | tool_routing | deterministic_validator | rag_index | lora_adapter
candidate_schema.baseline_eval_ref: path to baseline_report.md run this candidate is compared against
candidate_schema.verifier: role or model that reviewed this candidate, must differ from the model that produced it
